content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the removal of the IPU1 functional clock's parent source during the conversion to the new clkctrl layout, which led to the loss of the correct clock source parenting for the IPU1 mux clock. This resulted in the IPU1 not functioning correctly, as it was no longer receiving the appropriate clock signal from the intended source (dpll_core_h22x2_ck), affecting its operational frequency and independence from the ABE DPLL.
